github-opening.browserOpeningIsAvailable: Browser opening is available in the desktop app.
github-opening.resourceOwnerTheOfficialF: Resource owner: <s0/>. The official form defaults to All repositories. Choose Only select repositories and select the repositories this profile needs.
github-opening.metadataContentsPullReque: Metadata, Contents, Pull requests, Issues and Commit statuses are preselected as read-only, with a 30-day expiry. The verified form offers no Checks permission; access must be checked separately. Organization approval may be required.
github-opening.classicRepoGrantsBroadRea: Classic repo grants broad read/write access to private repositories even though DeliDev only reads GitHub APIs. Prefer fine-grained selected repositories when possible.
github-opening.noClassicScopesWillBePres: No classic scopes will be preselected for public repository lookup.
github-opening.reviewTheFormAndCreateThe: Review the form and create the token yourself, then enter it in the protected token field below. Opening a form does not create or save a token.
github-opening.openTheOfficialFormFromTh: Open the official form from the desktop app or use the CLI token-form command.
